Typically local, but not touristy. (at least not on 31.7.25 at 18:30 h)
Jul 2025 • Friends
One of my Vietnamese friends invited us here as a group. I was the only European in the group of eight, everyone else was from all parts of Vietnam.
During the meal, I was taken into consideration and attentively always asked beforehand if I could not tolerate this or that. I like sea food. The sea food soup is very good. There was so much fish, squid & meat coming that I don't remember everything. But I certainly won't forget one thing (in a positive sense): Jelly Fish, the jellyfish. That was really good in the hot pot and to recommend. Staff are also extraordinarily friendly. As the only non-Vietnamese, I was always personally prepared the soup (with thin and thick noodles). Really recommended. AC is also very pleasant and not too cold.

Another Great Recommendation by Mr Tri
Jul 2018 • Family
If you want a foodie tour, please get Mr Tri - it’s pronounced as Tori (I think you can get his number from Kok Thai Travels). 

Let’s just say all that we ordered is great. Though the grill leatherjacket fish is the most underwhelming dish of all as it was not as surprising and novel to us than all the other dishes.

What we had:
1. Snails - fresh, crunchy snails coated with sticky sweet spicy sauce. 
2. Grilled pork rice paper rolls (DIY so you will have nice chewy rice paper rolls). Discovered the horror of fish leaves. The blast of fishiness with just a bite into the harmless looking greens. But it is the most expensive leave on the platter so learn to love it 😉
3. Jellyfish salad - best I ever had. Malaysia don’t serve jellyfish as fresh as this in salad.
4. Mincemeat snail - the texture is - try it yourself. 😏
5. Fried rice had good flavour but I find it too small of a portion. 
6. Wild leaves and a special dip. I couldn’t get enough of that sauce!!!

Jolly good
Jan 2018 • Family
Except for the fact that this place is a little bit off the track from central Saigon, it definitely is a restaurant quite worth visiting to enjoy excellent Vietnamese Nha Trang style cuisine. 
All dishes presented to us were of prime quality, very tasty, and sophistically prepared, which we eventually did enjoyed quite a lot.
The service is impeccable under the supervision of an outstanding owner host.
As we were invited, it's difficult to evaluate the quality/cost ratio, but looking at costs from the menu it looked rather reasonable.
From all points of view, we certainly were not disappointed what so ever.
So enjoy the show.
